newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Hellaby to buy back shares at NZ$1.85.
newsitem.headline: Hellaby to buy back shares at NZ$1.85.

text.p: Investment company Hellaby Holdings Ltd on Thursday set a NZ$1.85 price for its pro rata share repurchase offer and confirmed the ratio as one share for every five held.
The company said the offer would be forwarded to shareholders on November 6 and the price was based on the weighted average of shares traded on the stock exchange in the past three weeks.

Record date is November 1, acceptances are due by December 6 and payment will be made on December 12. The offer is for 11.9 million of the 59.3 million shares on issue and is subject to acceptance of not fewer than 8.5 million shares.
If accepted in full, the company's paid up capital will reduce by $21.9 million.
Hellaby shares gained three cents to $1.95 after the announcement. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
